evidence: Has the Tests label and updates the functional test framework runner (`test/functional/test_runner.py`) with direct execution mode and test manifest emission.
rationale: Adds test harness capabilities enabling individual functional tests to be queried and executed directly by external test runners. The author explains that this makes functional tests "visible to CTest-aware IDEs, CTest dashboards, CDash, and all other downstream tooling", offering clear developer convenience while being reasonably deferrable.
